videos.title: Learn Farm Animals for Kids | Cow, Pig, Sheep & More | Bibi Buzz TV
videos.description:
Let's learn about farm animals and the sounds they make with Bibi the bee! Kids will see each picture, hear the word and a simple sentence, and then play a fun quiz.

In this video: Cow, Pig, Sheep, Duck, Chicken, Horse, Goat, Rooster, Dog, Cat, Rabbit.
